svg.aria-label: CFEL: Collision, Failure, Evidence, and Learning Feedback
svg.title: CFEL: Collision, Failure, Evidence, and Learning Feedback
svg.desc: CFEL records the difference between expectation and observation, blocks unchanged blind retries, and turns failure into bounded evidence for a revised model. Relation: defines-concept.
